name: Shenzhen Lifotronic Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Lifotronic Technology Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and markets medical devices for diagnostics, therapy, clinical medicine, skin, and human health related purposes in China. It offers a comprehensive range of in vitro diagnostic equipment and reagents, including electrochemiluminescence immunoassay analyzers, glycated hemoglobin analyzers, specific protein analyzers, blood analyzers, and related testing reagents, serving hospitals, health check-up centers, and third-party medical testing institutions.
